lessons.trigger_condition: V411 could adapt screen priorities for Pokémon, ONE PIECE and NARUTO, but game identity and tablet market-lens controls were still fixed in source. Current 2026 official product pipelines and secondary-market catalog depth show additional active TCG ecosystems that should be discoverable without granting runtime source-rewrite authority.
lessons.prevention_rule: Use a strict declarative tcg_game_registry.json. Core games remain protected. New games require official-live evidence, independent market evidence, configured depth and activation-score gates before promoted market/release/promo/purchase surfaces. Review the registry after the existing eight mandatory collectors without adding a ninth blocker. Unknown insufficiently verified names remain watch-only. New-game grading stays disabled until separate calibration. Never guarantee profit, predict price direction, track user behavior, generate source code or write Git/main.
validation_required: registry contains core Pokémon ONE PIECE NARUTO and promoted GUNDAM CARD GAME UNION ARENA DRAGON BALL SUPER FUSION WORLD Disney Lorcana Star Wars Unlimited and Riftbound
profit guarantee investment-return prediction and market-direction prediction are false
new games can use market release promo purchase surfaces while grading remains false until separate calibration
unknown local names remain watch candidates without the marketplace-depth gate
registry review is auxiliary after the immutable eight mandatory collection jobs
registry failure cannot stop the mandatory collection cycle
tablet market lens consumes declarative allowed_games instead of a fixed three-game gate
promo and purchase selectors are populated from promoted registry rows
tcg_game_registry.json is exposed by the local updater and PWA cache
screen neural remains exactly 17 inputs 12 hidden units and 18 allowlisted outputs
runtime source generation arbitrary commands Git/main writes and verification bypass remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V412 expands declarative TCG market categories and periodic evidence review only. It does not guarantee investment returns, infer future prices, invent stock or sales, auto-enable uncalibrated grading, rewrite source at runtime, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, track user behavior, or bypass existing V399/V400/neural gates.
